title: quadlet: discover template instances from drop-in directories
body:
Currently, Quadlet only reads an instance's drop-ins (xyz@abc.container.d/) if an explicit instance file or symlink for that instance already exists. This requires users to create an extra instance file or symlink even when they only want to override a few directives.

To fix this, scan the unit search paths for drop-in directories whose base name has no corresponding on-disk unit file but matches a loaded template (e.g. xyz@.container). For each one found, create an in-memory copy of the template renamed to the instance name, before the existing drop-in-merging and service-generation logic runs. Explicit instance files and symlinks still take priority and are left untouched.

Add tests for instance discovery, drop-in merging across search paths, and isolation between instances.

Fixes: #27636
